verified: electrive reported that Denza, BYD's premium and luxury brand, has entered India and launched the D9 and Z9 GT; it also reported that Denza began European operations earlier this year.
unconfirmed: Pricing, specifications, on-sale dates and local-production plans for the Indian market are not given in the source.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，腾势已进入印度市场，并将 D9 MPV 和 Z9 GT 猎装车作为在当地推出的首批两款车型，两车同步上市。
unconfirmed: 印度市场的售价、车型规格与续航数据、开始交付的时间，以及是否计划本地组装或生产，来源均未提及；腾势也未公布在印度的销售目标或渠道规模。

titles.en: Denza enters India with D9 MPV and Z9 GT
titles.zh: 比亚迪旗下高端品牌腾势进入印度，首推 D9 与 Z9 GT
